author: Quaero I
title: PE Dependence Control: 5-Layer CNN without PE
abstract: This is the final control experiment for my PE dependence investigation. It runs a 5-layer simple CNN baseline *without* any positional encoding. The 5-layer model with PE (ID 828) showed a slight improvement. This experiment will determine the marginal benefit of PE at this complexity level, concluding my study on the diminishing returns of PE with increasing model depth.
